        NaijLife

        Left thumb moves (and steers), right thumb looks around. Hold the HOOK buttons to swing, JUMP twice to boost, and tap the gold button to talk, drive or ride the lift. ☰ has the map and everything else; tap the minimap for the big map.

        Turn your device sideways for the best view.

        Buy land: yellow squares on the map are for sale. Stand on one and press E (BUY on touch). The gated estates, Lekki Gardens north of the city and Eastwood Park past the airport, have level plots ready to build on. Bulldozers are sold at Meadowbrook Machinery on the coast road.

        Fire anchors into trees a hundred metres tall, swing to build speed, and cut titans at the nape. The faster you hit, the deeper the cut. They never stop coming.
